feeds.title: Carrots Are Orange
feeds.description: A Montessori learning resource for parents, teachers, and homeschoolers. Founder Marnie Craycroft is a mom of 3 boys, runner, Mainer, twin, nature nerd, partner to an extremely patient guy.

feeds.title: Recreational Kayaking in Maine
feeds.description: A user friendly blog to locate places to kayak in Maine. It includes launch sites, directions, parking/facility details and photographs. Kimberlee Bennett is the author behind the blog and is a mom to three kids.

feeds.title: Sarah Laurence Blog
feeds.description: I am Sarah. I'm an artist and a book junkie. I grew up in NYC and now live in Maine with my British husband and a dog called Scout. We have two children. I write fiction & review books for adults & teens.

feeds.title: Searsport Shores
feeds.description: Searsport Shores Oceanfront Campground is a home of passion and livelihood. Astrig is the author behind of blog and likes all things Maine.

feeds.title: Weekends in Maine
feeds.description: Subscribe to my blog for some great ideas on amazing places to visit, interesting activites and other fun things to do in Maine!

feeds.title: Ashley Langtry Photography
feeds.description: I am Ashley, a photographer based in Portland, Maine. I am a mom to two crazies, and a wife to my childhood sweetheart. I specialize in capturing timeless, organic images for newborns, and families and creating custom photographic experiences.

feeds.title: Mainely Parents
feeds.description: A Maine lifestyle blog centered around motherhood, family, wellness, and New England living. Mainely Keating is a local Maine moms blog and resource guide designed to help inspire and connect moms all across Southern Maine.
